title: Consecutive naturality of the explicit ordinary quotient level maps
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, P any A-module cochain complex, and L_n⊣Res_n any supplied quotient derived adjunctions. Use the explicit maps c_n and ordinary tensor diagram T(P) of [lem-weil-pbc-adic-ordinary-tensor-levels], and the canonical quotient diagram D of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-quotient-diagram]. For every n, D_(n+1→n) followed by c_n equals c_(n+1) followed by Q of the actual quotient transition T(P)_(n+1→n). This asserts only the square for the prescribed maps, not their invertibility. In particular no K-flatness, boundedness, finiteness, completeness or sheaf hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Write q_n for the quotient map, U_n for restriction and eta_n for ordinary scalar insertion. By the proved unit equation of the explicit level maps, composing the defining derived transpose with its unit gives Q(eta_n), because the exact restriction factorization maps cancel. The consecutive quotient tensor map is linear over A/I^(n+2), with the target action restricted along the quotient homomorphism.

Undo the exact restriction and symmetry comparisons and the specified composition isomorphism U_n≅U_(n+1)∘Res(A/I^(n+2)→A/I^(n+1)). Both maps in the proposed square are now restrictions of maps with target the restricted nth ordinary extension complex. Apply injectivity of the (n+1)st adjunction Hom bijection. The canonical transition transposes to the lower unit by its definition. The other transpose is the ordinary coefficient quotient map composed with upper scalar insertion. In every cochain degree this sends x to the image of 1 tensor x, namely 1 tensor x, since quotient homomorphisms preserve 1. Thus it is lower scalar insertion. These maps commute with differentials by naturality of insertion. The canonical exact restriction composition isomorphism is the localization of the ordinary identity-on-elements restriction comparison, so its factorization transports the equality to the two transposes. Injectivity proves the square. No K-flatness or invertibility is used.

lean.statement:
theorem adicOrdinaryTensorLevelMap_transition
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (L : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} A) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))))
    (adj : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⊣ DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction I n)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} A) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (finitePerfectAdicQuotientDiagram I L adj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).map
        (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫
        adicOrdinaryTensorLevelMap I L adj P n =
      adicOrdinaryTensorLevelMap I L adj P (n + 1) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adicOrdinaryTensorComplexDiagram I P).map
          (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
